description: Submission tracker for a launchkit run. One entry per planned route. States are evidence-based: 'prepared' means assets are drafted but nothing was sent; 'submitted' means the platform acknowledged intake (draft under review counts here only if the platform accepted it for review); 'scheduled' means the platform confirmed a future date/slot; 'live' means a public listing URL resolves in a logged-out browser; 'rejected' means the platform refused; 'blocked' means a gate stopped work (login, CAPTCHA, payment, unmet condition); 'skipped' means deliberately not attempted.

entries.state: planned | prepared | submitted | scheduled | live | rejected | blocked | skipped
entries.evidence: public listing URL, confirmation reference, or null — required for submitted/scheduled/live
entries.notes: free text: what happened, queue position, review window, blockers
entries.updated: ISO 8601 datetime of last state change
entries.attempts: integer count of work sessions on this route

stateRules.prepared: Legal maximum for saved drafts that were never sent.
stateRules.submitted: Requires evidence of platform intake acknowledgement.
stateRules.scheduled: Requires evidence the platform confirmed a date or slot.
stateRules.live: Requires a resolving public URL recorded in evidence.
stateRules.blocked: Must record the blocking condition in notes.
